selection_from_the_verdicts_made_before_.rule: keep a change only if its verdict is confirmed, or weakened with an effect still positive after the attacks (verifier's numbers); at most one change per sleeve, the largest total-R gain after the attacks. For breadth, a new pair is a new sleeve on an instrument; the lens ranked its qualifiers per instrument ('rank_for_its_sleeve'), and this synthesis keeps at most one new pair per instrument (the hands allow 2 positions per symbol; pairs on the same instrument are largely the same bet).

budget: at most 9 variant lines (R0, C1, N1, N2, I3, P0, P1, P2, P3), each run once in fp and once in x1.5; plus non-variant lines (truncation tests, descriptive anatomy). Nothing is tuned: every rule and parameter is frozen as attacked.

portfolio_metrics.window: trades entered 2018-02-01 .. 2021-12-31 (the common in-sample window of the ten sleeves); trades still open at the end of their in-sample slice are excluded (no in-sample result). Earlier years reported separately where a frame starts earlier.
portfolio_metrics.stake: constant: every trade risks 1 R; no compounding, no position cap (each sleeve one position at a time)
portfolio_metrics.metrics: number of trades; expectancy per trade in R (and x 100 = euros earned per 100 euros risked); win rate; average win; average loss; profit factor; total R; worst week (server week Monday-Sunday, server time = New York + 7 h, booked at exit); maximum drawdown in R on the cumulative R in exit order and on the weekly sums; longest run of consecutive losing weeks (weeks with no exit count as 0, not losing); mean / standard deviation of R per trade; weekly mean / standard deviation; per year 2018-2021; halves 2018-02..2019-12 and 2020-01..2021-12
portfolio_metrics.costs: FP (r2.costs(sym), frame as stored) and x1.5 (spread and slippage x1.5 around the mid, orders rebuilt on the widened quotes); a stop closer than 3 spreads of the fill bar is not taken (order removed, sleeve re-simulated)

truncation_tests.T1: K1: for 30 brk72 ethusd signals of 2019-2021 (15 skipped, 15 kept, the nearest to the threshold, plus random, seed 7), the frame is cut to the bars that start before the decision time D, plus 1 provisional bar at D; stop_dist, P, riskbp, T(Y) and the skip decision are recomputed and must be identical.
truncation_tests.T2: K2/K3: for 20 orb trades per instrument (seed 7), the frame is cut right after the touch bar plus 3 flat provisional bars; the order of that day (entry bar time, side, level, stop) must be identical.

descriptive_anatomy_no_variant: on the R0 trades, 2018-02..2021-12, FP: per sleeve losers, average loss, share of losses at a full stop (R <= -0.9), share of the gross loss from them, winners whose adverse excursion reached 0.5 R before they won, losers whose favourable excursion reached 1 R before they lost (simulator mfe / mae divided by the initial risk).
